note: Chrono build provenance for the Go2 excitation collection. Two Chrono builds exist on kyle-sbel and the source build shadows the conda one only when it is on PYTHONPATH; omitting it produces different physics with no error. This file records which build each dataset was produced with, and how that was established.

divergence_measured.method: same seed, same arguments, 2 windows, only PYTHONPATH differed
divergence_measured.comment: The wrong build does not fail. It produces 115 differing columns and exits 0. This is why a version string is insufficient: a version is what a build claims, a hash is what it is.

go2_exc_b40_c2.evidence: live /proc/<pid>/maps showed the source _core.so mapped, plus PYTHONPATH in /proc/<pid>/environ

go2_exc_b40.evidence: Re-ran window 0 under the fingerprinted collector (--windows 1 --seed 21 --window-rows 40 --bursts 4 --recover-rows 60, --action-scale 0.3 --branch-from-policy) and compared the 183 numeric physics columns against the original: BIT-IDENTICAL, 0 differing. The collector uses one RNG consumed sequentially from window 0, so one window reproduces the first episode exactly, and a single process shares its build across all its episodes.
go2_exc_b40.note: A mismatch would have had two possible causes -- wrong build, or a code change between then and now. A match rules out both simultaneously, so this also confirms the rows_written accumulator and the fingerprint print are physics-neutral.

go2_exc_b10.evidence: Re-ran window 0 under the fingerprinted collector (--windows 1 --seed 22 --window-rows 10 --bursts 16 --recover-rows 12, --action-scale 0.3 --branch-from-policy) and compared the 183 numeric physics columns against the original: BIT-IDENTICAL, 0 differing. The collector uses one RNG consumed sequentially from window 0, so one window reproduces the first episode exactly, and a single process shares its build across all its episodes.
go2_exc_b10.note: A mismatch would have had two possible causes -- wrong build, or a code change between then and now. A match rules out both simultaneously, so this also confirms the rows_written accumulator and the fingerprint print are physics-neutral.

go2_exc_C.note: PERMANENTLY UNGRADEABLE, and not because the build is unknowable. The one-window reproduction test that settled go2_exc_b40 and go2_exc_b10 needs the seed and arguments, and summary.json did not record them at the time. The collector now writes seed and argv, so this gap closes going forward but cannot be closed backwards.

fix: scripts/collection/collect_go2_excitation.py now calls chrono_fingerprint() at startup, prints the build, writes the full record to summary.json, and stamps an 8-char chrono_build column on every row so the marker survives pooling. Datasets collected before this commit carry no such marker, which is why this file exists. summary.json now also records seed and argv, because the reproduction test that settles build provenance is only available when the run can be re-run.
what_verified_does_not_cover: Every 'verified' grade here rests on one untested assumption: that a single collector process loads one Chrono build for the whole of its run. That is true of a normally behaved dynamic loader and no mechanism in this code reloads pychrono, but it is an argument, not a measurement, and the point of this file is that those differ. MITIGATION, already in place: the per-row chrono_build column means a violation announces itself -- a run whose rows carry two different tags is visible in the pooled set without anyone going looking. Until such a case appears, read 'verified' as 'verified given one build per process'.

two_layers.traceability: what did this run use? -- the chrono hash, the config. Recorded.
two_layers.verifiability: can this run be re-executed? -- the seed, the argv. Recorded only from 2026-09-06.
two_layers.note: Recording the first without the second gives a dataset you can describe and cannot check. go2_exc_C looks fully documented until someone tries to reproduce it, which may be long after the information could have been captured for free.
